question: Economist/YouGov generic congressional ballot: the Democratic margin (Democratic percent minus Republican percent) for the 2026 US House elections
withdrawn_reason: the question asks for the registered-voter generic ballot, but Economist/YouGov moved it to likely voters from the 9/4-8 wave (n about 1,400 to about 1,000; margin 6 to 11-14). The resolved value is a likely-voter number, and no registered-voter reading exists to correct it to. Voided for every entrant; see #178 (A, rows 12-14).
